about.title: Irvine Wrongful Death Claims
about.longDescription: Ten people died in Irvine traffic collisions in 2025, according to the most recent final-year records. Each of those numbers was a person with a family, and some of those families are now asking what happens next. A wrongful death claim in California is a civil action, separate from any criminal case or police investigation. It allows a surviving spouse or domestic partner and children, and in some cases other dependents or heirs, to seek compensation for funeral and burial costs, the financial support the person would have provided, and the loss of their love, companionship and guidance. Irvine's collisions cluster along I-5 in both directions, I-405 northbound and Culver Drive, and reported crashes tend to peak on Fridays between 5 and 7 p.m. Fatal cases in Orange County can involve commercial carriers, multiple insurers, or a government entity, which shortens the filing deadline considerably. LawProactive is not a law firm. We simply connect you with an independent attorney who handles wrongful death matters, at no cost to you, so you can focus on your family.

items.title: Clarity on Who Can File
items.desc: California limits wrongful death standing to a spouse or domestic partner and children first, then certain dependents and heirs. The attorney we connect you with can explain where your family fits before anything is filed.

items.title: The Two-Year Clock, Explained
items.desc: Most claims must be filed within two years of the date of death, but the window is much shorter when a city, county, or state agency is involved. Knowing which deadline applies early protects your family's ability to act.

items.title: No Fee Unless There Is a Recovery
items.desc: Our service is free, and attorneys in our network work on contingency. Recoverable losses can include funeral costs, lost financial support, and the loss of love, companionship and guidance.

items.question: My spouse was killed on I-5 in Irvine and the other driver was charged. Do I still need a civil case?
items.answer: Yes, a criminal case and a wrongful death claim are separate proceedings with different purposes. The criminal case is brought by the state and does not compensate your family. A civil wrongful death action is how a surviving spouse or domestic partner seeks recovery for funeral costs, lost support, and the loss of companionship. Both can move forward at the same time.

items.question: How long do we have to file a wrongful death claim in California?
items.answer: Generally, two years from the date of death. If a government entity may share responsibility, such as a public road or city vehicle, a claim typically must be presented in a matter of months, not years. Because that difference is so significant, it helps to speak with an attorney sooner rather than later.

items.question: Is LawProactive a law firm, and what does it cost?
